content.text:
`tailscale serve 3000` = `expose localhost:3000 on https://<your-machine>.ts.net:443`

You only get **one listener per port** — `443` is already taken by a previous `serve`/`funnel`. Second one = `listener already exists`.

Check what's on it:

```bash
tailscale serve status
```

Fix - reset and re-create:

```bash
sudo tailscale serve reset
sudo tailscale serve 3000
```

Or keep existing and add a path instead of `/`:

```bash
sudo tailscale serve --https=443 --set-path=/app http://127.0.0.1:3000
```

> `serve` = tailnet only, `funnel` = public internet. If you previously ran `tailscale funnel 3000` it also holds `443`.
